results.content:
The University of Michigan's Surveys of Consumers said on Friday its Consumer Sentiment Index increased to a final ​reading of 55.2 from 54.4 earlier ​this month. The index was at 49.5 ⁠in June. Economists polled by Reuters had ​forecast the index dipping to a final reading of ​54.0.
